# Vedryx Pulse

Vedryx Pulse helps non-technical founders launch market-ready products in 19 days. Vedryx acts as the founder's entire technical department — strategy, design, engineering, QA, and launch are handled end-to-end with no CTO or dev team required.

## Core Offering

- 19-day end-to-end product build, from idea to live product
- Senior-led engineering with ruthlessly scoped first release
- Day-by-day delivery protocol: strategy & design (days 1–4), core engineering (5–15), refinement (16–17), final review (18), launch day (19)
- Outcome-first approach focused on business goals over tech stack debates
- Build types supported: SaaS platforms, mobile apps, AI-native products, digital marketplaces
- Founder handoff includes a live product, launch assets, and an operating plan
- Offline commercial contract between Vedryx and the founder
- Ongoing iteration and growth support available after launch

## Primary Pages

- Home: https://pulse.vedryxtech.com/

## Parent Brand

Vedryx Pulse is a product of Vedryx (https://vedryxtech.com/), which also offers dedicated remote developer placement for established companies.
